description: This file defines a Nextcloud provider class with methods for file management, sharing, and synchronization with a Nextcloud server, used within a larger application for recipe management.

classes.name: Nextcloud
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with Nextcloud storage, including file import, sharing, retrieval, renaming, and deletion.

methods.name: get_client
methods.description: Creates and returns a WebDAV client configured for the given storage.

methods.name: import_all
methods.description: Imports all recipes from the specified storage path, avoiding duplicates, and logs the operation.

methods.name: create_share_link
methods.description: Creates a share link for a given recipe file on Nextcloud.

methods.name: get_share_link
methods.description: Retrieves an existing share link for a recipe file, or creates one if none exists.

methods.name: get_file
methods.description: Downloads a recipe file from Nextcloud and returns it as a BytesIO object.

methods.name: rename_file
methods.description: Renames a recipe file on Nextcloud.

methods.name: delete_file
methods.description: Deletes a recipe file from Nextcloud.
